CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 07 / 10

Efficiency and welfare

Efficient equilibrium有效率均衡

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain why, in the competitive model without relevant market failures, the equilibrium quantity maximizes total surplus: trade units for which marginal value is at least marginal cost.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

沒有相關市場失靈的競爭模型中，應完成邊際價值高於成本的交易。均衡使兩者相等，偏離該數量會失去總剩餘。

In a competitive market without relevant market failures, trade units for which marginal buyer value exceeds marginal cost. At equilibrium, marginal value equals marginal cost; increasing or decreasing quantity from that point cannot raise total surplus.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：An extra unit valued at $9 costs $6. Making it adds $3 surplus, so output below that unit leaves gains unrealized. 這項交易增加三元總收益。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Marginal value is $8 and marginal cost $5. Efficient action? 邊際價值八、成本五？
